# Verifies that a `locale("...")` provider block threads the literal locale
# through to i18n stdlib calls in its subtree at compile time, with the
# provider-block var promoted to Model state. Locks the end-to-end behavior
# demonstrated by hand in 932834d so it doesn't regress.

sngl generate --platform=bubbletea --lang=go --out=out app.sngl
exists out/model.go

# i18n runtime package is imported.
grep '"git.duckfam.us/jonathan/sngl/pkg/go/i18n"' out/model.go

# locale("es-MX") provider threads to the i18n.NumberInt call as the first arg.
grep 'i18n.NumberInt\("es-MX",' out/model.go

# Provider-block var `price` is promoted to Model state (field + setter).
grep 'price' out/model.go

-- app.sngl --
output { go { bubbletea } }

component main {
    var n = 1234
    locale("es-MX") {
        var price = i18n.numberInt(n, "decimal")
        text(value=price)
    }
}
